data.text:
Yung nanay ko at buong sangkatauhan nag message sa akin to ask if interim release na ba si PRRD, because there’s a video going around that’s  an excerpt from Alvin & Tourism’s live with me and Alvin saying “thank You Jesus” and some people think it’s us celebrating PRRD’s interim release. 

Cut kasi sya. What happened was Alvin showed us the update from ICC saying that the Philippines filed NO PROTEST on the conditions of interim release. 

Ang meaning nyan, kung ano ang ni request ng defense team ni PRRD, ok lang sa Pilipinas. Hindi ibig sabihin na I release na si PRRD now.

But we are happy because the update is very crucial: Interim release REQUIRES the cooperation of the country / state that surrendered the accused. 

Meaning, if the PH filed a protest sa interim release, hindi ma release si PRRD. But it didn’t. 
Which moves us closer to the interim release. 

There’s also a third country that offered to host PRRD. And PRRD cannot be released if no host state (na member ng ICC) ang mag agree to host him. 

So what we are happy about is that this moves us much closer to the possibility of the interim release. 

The Defense team and the PH both have no objection to the conditions given by ICC. A very important condition yan na both state and defense team will agree. 

So what’s next? The ICC judges will decide if they will grant interim release na. Based on the conditions they gave: for example, travel restrictions for PRRD, host country restrictions, etc.

Interim release means PRRD will just wait in this country while waiting for his trial.

So that’s why prayers are most needed now kasi all the conditions have been met — judgment nalang ng ICC ang kulang. More prayers more prayers more prayers.

Major hurdle gone. Now on to praying that the ICC judges hand down the decision asap. Yun na lang. God will make a way. Whether or not makauwi si PRRD sa atin, Basta importante wala sa detention si PRRD. 

Personally speaking, and opinion ko lang, I think that’s why Kaufman wanted to meet BBM, kasi he would like to probably request if the PH can allow PRRD back home. Kasi you need approval from that country. But in any case, kahit anong country man yan, at least wala sa loob ng kulungan si PRRD para makakain man lang sya ng bulad nya. Sa loob kasi ng ICC severely limited sya. 

Join us today September 27 in front of the ICC, from 1 pm to 5 pm, please so we can tell the world of our support for PRRD.

— Kiffy Chu
